decisions.statement: A world over bodies held in memory is built here rather than by each test.
A world over bodies written into an indexed repo is built here rather than by each test.
That world lists the paths its bodies are held under.
That world's index names no importer of any path.
A world whose index answers what a page type carries is built here rather than by each test.
One such property is built here rather than by each test.
A world reaching one address is built here rather than by each test.
A reach gathering what it was asked is built here rather than by each test.
A reach refusing at one address gathers what it was asked before refusing.
A world answering one page and one body is built here rather than by each test.
A ledger whose index answers for one page type, its properties and values is built here.
That ledger's index answers the shapes a test states, and no shape otherwise.
A world recording the change reached rather than running it is built here rather than by each test.
That world answers the answer the test states.
A test stating no answer is answered an answer with no edit.
An index face is built here from the answers a test states.
A face answers nothing where the test states no answer.
An answer with one edit is read here for the body that edit leaves.
An answer is read here for the body that answer leaves at a path named.
An answer that refused is caught here before the body it left is read.
A reaching built here refuses every address that reaching was not built for.
A refusal is read here whether the change said the refusal or the replay found the refusal.

definition: the worlds, reaches and answers a change's tests are set up with
